messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty CRITICAL — INC-2026-032 triggered: 5xx rate > 5% (3m window) for service=ingress-gateway-usw2. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-2026-032
maria: Acked. i'm on it. @dave-oncall can you take lead?
dave-oncall: Taking lead. quick triage: errors are 502/504 from auth-proxy/token-service. spike started ~2026-03-17T19:03:00Z.
ben: No deploys in last 60m (deploy-bot clear). infra shows auth-proxy replicas saturated (~95% CPU).
carol: SLO dashboard: error budget burn ~4% in last 5m; affected routes /v1/embed and /v1/generate. top customers: acct-42, partner-x.
dave-oncall: tailing logs:
```
[2026-03-17T19:04:10Z] auth-proxy 502 POST /auth token=jwt-abc upstream=token-service timeout=28s
[2026-03-17T19:04:11Z] auth-proxy 504 POST /auth token=jwt-def upstream=token-service deadline-exceeded
[2026-03-17T19:04:12Z] ingress-gw 502 POST /v1/embed user=acct-42 upstream=auth-proxy connection-reset
```
maria: Client IPs show a concentrated set of a few addresses — likely a partner integration doing aggressive retries.
dave-oncall: Mitigation step 1: enable temporary per-IP rate limit on /v1/embed and /v1/generate and route those endpoints to fallback-slim pool (lower mem, more concurrency). Applying now. :wrench:
incident-bot: config-change executed: change-id=cfg-984. ingress rate-limit and route swap applied.
ben: Metrics 90s after change: global 5xx rate down from 6.7% -> 0.8%. tail latency +10% but within SLO.
carol: Notifying partner success and support teams. Opening PD timeline note and creating a support ticket for partner-x to check client retries.
dave-oncall: Scaling auth proxies as secondary mitigation: kubectl scale deployment auth-proxy -n prod --replicas=6
maria: Capturing traces for affected request-ids and saving to /tmp/incidents/INC-2026-032/traces.tar.gz
eve: Ack, picking up monitoring for the next 2 hours. Will escalate to infra-oncall if 5xx > 1% again.
partner-success: Notified partner-x. They've acknowledged noisy retry behavior and will throttle client.
incident-bot: INC-2026-032 acknowledged by dave-oncall — status: mitigated, monitoring. Auto-close scheduled in 50m if stable.
